ValidationRule.description: Validation to ensure only admins and sales users can update a Lead status from Engage to Qualified or Disqualified.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Qualified"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Disqualified"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Re-Nurture") ), $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", NOT($Permission.Sales_User_Permission_CC), NOT($CustomMetadata.Trigger_Framework_Config_CC__mdt.Lead.Bypass_Validation_CC__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only sales users and admins can move the status
